description: Leray DSS search in a log-phase trial basis (arbitrary precision; numerical exploration, NOT a proof).
q0AnchorReason: Arb Newton/continuation search for Leray self-similar Navier-Stokes profiles in a log-phase trial basis; no substrate q is read or evaluated anywhere.
trial_tail: (1+rho)^-(p + i theta m w); theta=1: mode m decays like |y|^(-1-2imw)
method: least-squares Gauss-Newton (normal equations, 1e-45 Tikhonov shift) with backtracking line search on |F|; d/domega by FD (h=1e-30)
